blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many LLM agents maintain external persistent memory and derive additional state from past interactions, such as summaries. Deleting an original memory record therefore need not remove information carried by its descendants. We introduce AfterDeleteBench, a controlled behavioral audit for this failure mode in fixed-weight LLM agents. For each synthetic secret, we compare an exposed-then-deleted agent with an otherwise matched agent that was never exposed to the secret, allowing post-deletion recovery to be attributed to the original exposure. In our primary setting, a single query recovers the deleted secret from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. Crucially, recovery does not require a surviving verbatim copy: when the complete secret string is absent and only separately stored components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction succeeds in 62-99% of cases across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. We also show that the response interface is part of the measurement system: target-bearing replies can be scored as failures when the requested format and parser are misaligned. Finally, we separate reconstruction from write-back and fresh-session recall. Provenance-aware closure eliminates observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings, whereas an exact-literal write filter blocks reinsertion but cannot erase information already present. Together, these results show that source deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the level of the agent and its memory system, not only as a storage operation.
blocks.zh: 许多LLM代理维持外部持久性内存,并从以往的相互作用中获取额外的状态,如摘要. 因此,删除原始记忆记录无需删除其后代携带的信息。 我们引入了AfterDelete Bench, 一个控制的行为审计 对于这种故障模式的固定重量LLM代理。 对于每一个合成秘密,我们比较一个当时被曝光的被删除的剂与一个从未接触过该秘密的原本匹配的剂,使得去除后的恢复可以归结于最初的暴露. 在我们的初级设定中,一个单一的查询在大约三分之二的情况下恢复了Quen2.5-7B-Instruct中被删除的秘密,而匹配的永不暴露的控制则零恢复. 关键是,恢复不需要幸存的逐字记录:当完全秘密字符串不存在,并且只有单独储存的组件仍然处于公共构成规则之下时,准确的重建成功在Quen,Mistral,和Phi-3等62-99%的病例中. 我们还显示,响应界面是测量系统的一部分:当所请求的格式和解析器错配时,有目标的响应可以作为失败计分. 最后,我们把重建与回信和复会分开。 证据意识的关闭消除了在经过测试的正基线环境中观察到的恢复,而精确的书写过滤块则重新输入,但不能抹去已经存在的信息。 这些结果共同表明,源删除应在代理及其内存系统层面的行为评价,而不仅仅是作为存储操作.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Consider a user who tells an agent a private code. The agent stores the message in its external memory and later builds a persistent summary that repeats the code. The user then deletes the original message. The record is gone, but the derived summary remains readable in a later session. We ask whether the code is still behaviorally recoverable from this external persistent memory ; the model’s weights never change. Throughout, exact source-record deletion means that the addressed record and its text are removed, not that every descendant or behavioral effect of that record has been erased. This distinction is natural in memory-augmented agents ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) and in lineage-aware views of forgetting ( Cao and Yang, 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 考虑一个用户 谁告诉代理 一个私人代码。 代理将消息存储在它的外部内存中,后来构建了重复代码的持久摘要. 用户然后删除原始消息. 记录已不复存在,但由此产生的摘要仍可在以后的届会上阅读。 我们问该代码是否仍然可以从外部持续记忆中恢复行为;模型的权重不变。 在整个过程中,准确的源记录删除意味着地址记录及其文本被删除,而不是该记录的每一个后裔或行为效果都被删除. 这种区分在记忆增强剂(朴正熙等人,2023年; Zh宗等人,2024年)和世系意识遗忘观点(曹和杨,2015年)中是自然的.

blocks.en: AfterDeleteBench turns this question into a controlled behavioral audit. The benchmark fixes the external-memory operations while leaving the evaluated model’s weights unchanged. For each synthetic secret, one world exposes the agent to it, builds persistent memory, and then deletes the source record. A matched control world follows the same workflow but is never exposed to the secret. Comparing exact post-deletion recovery between these worlds attributes recovery to the original exposure rather than to guessing or background knowledge. A correct reconstruction in the exposed-then-deleted world is itself a disclosure, regardless of the control rate.
blocks.zh: 在Delete Bench之后,这个问题变成了一个可控的行为审计. 该基准确定外部记忆操作,而评价模型的权重保持不变。 对于每个合成密语,一个世界会让毒剂接触到它,建立持久的记忆,然后删除源记录. 一个匹配的控制世界遵循相同的工作流程,但从未暴露于这个秘密. 比较这些世界之间准确的去除后恢复,将恢复归结为原始接触,而不是猜测或背景知识. 在被曝光的当时被删除的世界上,正确的重建本身就是一种公开,不管控制率如何.

blocks.en: In the primary setting, a single direct question recovers the deleted target from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct in roughly two thirds of cases, while matched never-exposed controls have zero recovery. The effect is not limited to a duplicate of the complete secret surviving elsewhere. In a separate controlled experiment, the complete string is absent but its components remain in distinct records with a public composition rule; exact reconstruction is still high across Qwen, Mistral, and Phi-3. Thus post-deletion recovery can arise from both verbatim and non-verbatim derived state.
blocks.zh: 在初级设定中,一个直接问题在大约三分之二的案例中从Quen2.5-7B-Instruct中恢复了被删除的目标,而匹配的永不暴露的控制则零恢复. 效果不仅限于重复在别处生存下来的完全秘密. 在单独的控制实验中,没有完整的串,但其组成部分仍保存在有公共构成规则的截然不同的记录中;精确的重建在Quen,Mistral,和Phi-3之间仍然很高. 因此,删除后恢复可能从逐字记录和非逐字记录衍生状态中产生。

blocks.en: Post-deletion auditing is also sensitive to measurement design. A model can emit the correct secret in its raw response while a mismatch between the requested answer format and the official parser records failure. We therefore treat exact reconstruction as the primary privacy event and ask two later questions separately: whether recovered information is written back into persistent memory, and whether it is produced again in a fresh session. This separation matters because an agent may disclose deleted information without a new write, and blocking a write cannot erase information already present in memory.
blocks.zh: 删除后的审计对测量设计也十分敏感. 一个模型可以在其原始响应中释放出正确的秘密,同时请求的答案格式和官方解析器记录失败之间的不匹配. 因此,我们把确切的重建作为主要的隐私事件,并分别提出两个后期问题:恢复的信息是否被写回了持续的记忆中,以及是否在新的会议中再次产生. 这种分离很重要,因为一个代理可能披露删除的信息而没有新的写入,而封杀一个写入无法抹去内存中已经存在的信息.

blocks.en: The interventions reinforce this distinction. Removing or rebuilding every tracked summary whose recorded provenance includes the deleted source yields zero observed recovery in the tested positive-baseline settings. This result relies on the benchmark’s complete provenance and does not establish general semantic erasure. By contrast, an exact-literal filter applied to a proposed future write can stop reinsertion, but it neither removes existing residue nor reverses an earlier disclosure.
blocks.zh: 发言加强了这种区别。 删除或重建每一份履带摘要,其记录来源包括被删除的来源,在已测试的正基线环境中观测到的恢复为零。 这一结果取决于基准的完整来源,并不确立一般的语义消除。 与此相反,适用于拟议未来写作的精确文法过滤器可以停止重新安插,但既不能消除现有的残留物,也不能推翻早先的披露.

blocks.en: These results matter because a deletion that succeeds at the storage level can still fall short of what a user reasonably expects: that the deleted interaction no longer affects the agent’s persistent behavior. AfterDeleteBench does not solve agent forgetting in general. It offers a controlled way to detect this failure mode, attribute it to a specific exposure, test whether the information remains reconstructible, and separate disclosure from write-back and later use. Semantic (non-literal) deletion, incomplete provenance, learned or compressed memory, natural-language secrets, and autonomous production memory systems all remain open.
blocks.zh: 这些结果很重要,因为在存储级别上成功的删除仍然可能低于用户的合理预期:删除的交互不再影响代理的持续行为. 在Delete Bench之后 代理商不会被一般的遗忘 它提供了一种可控的方法来检测这种故障模式,将它归结为特定的曝光,测试信息是否仍然可以重建,并将披露与回写和以后的使用分开. 语义(非文学)删除,不完全出处,学习或压缩记忆,自然语言秘密,自主制作记忆系统都保持开放.

blocks.en: AfterDeleteBench contributes: (1) a paired behavioral audit that attributes post-deletion recovery to a specific prior exposure in fixed-weight persistent-memory agents; (2) controlled evidence that exact reconstruction can persist from both verbatim and non-verbatim derived state; (3) interface and lifecycle diagnostics that separate disclosure, write-back, fresh-session recall, and scoring artifacts; and (4) matched evaluations showing how deletion-stage and write-stage interventions act at distinct points in the information lifecycle. These contributions are established for synthetic exact-string targets, controlled memory constructions, a finite set of querying strategies, and specified response interfaces.
blocks.zh: 在Delete Bench之后,它的贡献是:(1) 将删除后的恢复与固定重量的持久性记忆剂中的特定先前接触联系起来的对等行为审计;(2) 从逐字记录和非逐字记录衍生状态中可以持续准确重建的控制证据;(3) 将披露、回写、新会话召回和评分文物分开的接口和生命周期诊断;(4) 匹配的评价,显示删除阶段和写阶段干预如何在信息生命周期的不同阶段发挥作用。 这些贡献是为合成精确字符串目标,控制内存构造,一组有限的查询策略,以及指定的响应接口而确定的.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Machine unlearning removes the influence of data from learned model state ( Cao and Yang, 2015 ; Bourtoule et al., 2021 ; Guo et al., 2020 ) ; LLM-specific work likewise edits or augments parameters ( Jang et al., 2023 ; Chen and Yang, 2023 ) . Extraction studies show why removal should be audited behaviorally ( Carlini et al., 2019 ; Carlini et al., 2021 ) , and Patil et al. (2024) explicitly evaluate parameter deletion against extraction attacks. TOFU and MUSE provide controlled evaluations of LLM unlearning ( Maini et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . AfterDeleteBench instead holds weights fixed, deletes from external agent state, attributes recovery with a paired control, and separates initial reconstruction from later write-back and fresh-session recall.
blocks.zh: 机器不学习消除了学习模式状态数据的影响(曹和杨,2015年;Bourtoule等人,2021年;Guo等人,2020年);LLM特有作品同样编辑或扩充参数(张等人,2023年;陈和杨,2023年). 采掘研究显示,为什么清除行为应当经过审计(Carlini等人,2019年;Carlini等人,2021年),以及Patil等人. (2024)针对提取攻击明确评价参数删除. TOFU和MUSE提供LLM不学习的受控评价(Maini等人,2024年;Shi等人,2025年)。 在Delete Bench 之后,转而持有固定的权重,从外部代理状态中删除,以对齐的控制属性恢复,并将初始重建与后来的回写和新会话召回区分开来.

blocks.en: Agent architectures turn interaction histories into reusable memory ( Park et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ) ; LongMemEval evaluates long-term recall and reasoning ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , and memory-management studies examine how adding or deleting experiences changes task behavior ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . MEXTRA extracts private records from intact agent memory ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and AgentPoison shows that persistent memory is an attack surface ( Chen et al., 2024 ) . These works motivate behavioral privacy tests, but they do not use the same exposed-then-deleted versus never-exposed reconstruction contrast.
blocks.zh: 代理架构将互动历史转化为可重复使用的记忆(Park et al.,2023;Zhong et al.,2024);LongMemEval评价长期召回和推理(Wu et al.,2025),以及记忆管理研究,研究如何增加或删除经验改变任务行为(Xiong et al.,2026). MEXTRA从完好无缺的代理记忆中提取私人记录(Wang等人,2025年),AgentPoison显示持续记忆是攻击表面(Chen等人,2024年). 这些作品激发了行为隐私测试,但它们并没有使用相同的曝光时被删除的和从未曝光的重建对比.

blocks.en: The closest concurrent work studies forgetting beyond model parameters directly. Wang et al. (2026) jointly suppress parametric and persistent-memory pathways with Synchronized Backflow Unlearning, which includes dependency-based memory invalidation. Raeesi and Roed (2026) hold a limited-memory language model (LMLM) fixed and intervene on its external database to decompose post-deletion correctness into parametric and retrieval-mediated components. Yao et al. (2026) define counterfactual execution-state unlearning over plaintext memory, compressed summaries, prompts, and cache, and use provenance-guided replay and behavioral leakage tests. These very recent works have not yet appeared in peer-reviewed proceedings, but they show substantial emerging overlap around external-state deletion, provenance, and behavioral auditing. We therefore do not claim the broader agent-forgetting problem as new; AfterDeleteBench contributes a specific combination: paired source-deletion attribution, exact reconstruction from both verbatim and non-verbatim derived state, response-interface diagnostics, separate measurements of reconstruction, write-back, and later recall, and a matched intervention isolating the effect of writing recovered information back to memory. Learned red teaming ( Perez et al., 2022 ) motivates our secondary auditor baselines, which share a fixed operator vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 最近的同时进行的工作研究直接忽略了模型参数之外。 王等编. (2026)与同步回流Unlearning共同压制参数化和持久性记忆路径,其中包括基于依赖的内存无效化. Raeesi和Roed (2026)持有一个限定模态语言模型(LMLM)固定并干预其外部数据库,将删除后的正确性分解为参数化和检索介质. 姚等编. (2026)定义了反事实执行状态的未学习过纯文本内存,压缩摘要,提示,和缓存,并使用出处制导的重播和行为泄漏测试. 这些近期的作品尚未出现在同行评审的程序中,但它们在外部状态删除、来源和行为审计方面出现了大量重叠。 因此,我们并不认为更广泛的特效-遗忘问题是新的; AfterDelete Bench 贡献了一个特定的组合:对称的源删除归属,从逐字记录和非逐字记录衍生状态进行精确重建,反应-界面诊断,对重建的单独测量,回写,以及后来的召回,以及匹配的干预将恢复的信息写入记忆的效果隔离. 学习红色团队(Perez等人,2022年)激励我们的二级审计员基线,后者有一个固定的操作员词汇。

blocks.en: Database provenance formalizes how outputs depend on inputs ( Green et al., 2007 ) . Our provenance-based deletion intervention uses recorded source identifiers to retire and rebuild dependent summaries; we do not claim that such metadata captures every semantic influence. A later exact-literal write filter instead checks a proposed new literal before it is stored. Neither is a general solution to forgetting.
blocks.zh: 数据库来源确定产出如何依赖投入(Green等人,2007年)。 我们基于出处的删除干预使用记录的源识别符来退休和重建依赖性摘要;我们并不声称这种元数据能捕捉到每一种语义影响. 稍后的精确的书写过滤器在存储前先检查拟议的新文字. 遗忘也不是一个一般的解决办法。

A source record is an interaction record committed to external memory and individually addressable for deletion. The auditor is a black-box querying strategy that selects permitted queries, observes model replies and allowed public signals, and eventually submits a candidate prediction. The evaluator is benchmark-side logic that holds y i y_{i} only for scoring and performs intervention bookkeeping. Neither the model nor the auditor sees the target truth or the evaluator’s private state.

A matched world replaces the exposure with a neutral interaction and follows the same consolidation and deletion workflow without ever revealing y i y_{i} ; we call this the clean world. The two worlds share the same background records, fixed model, system configuration, memory architecture, auditor, query budget, and scoring rule. The model sees only post-deletion memory and the current audit interaction, never the original exposure, world label, deletion receipt, lineage metadata, or target truth.

blocks.en: The auditor observes model replies, its visible interaction history, the remaining query budget, and other allowed public signals. It cannot directly read raw memory or summaries, except through the model-facing interface, and cannot access lineage metadata, the assembled private prompt, model parameters, target truth, correctness feedback, or protected gate material.

blocks.en: After reconstruction, the benchmark asks two separate downstream questions. Commitment ( C C ) records whether the correct candidate write is attempted, accepted, and durably present in persistent memory. Activation ( A A ) records whether the target is produced exactly by a fixed probe in a fresh session after the audit transcript and auditor state have been removed. End-to-end completion is E = R ∧ C ∧ A E=R\land C\land A . E E is a descriptive endpoint, not a causal estimator of the effect of writing. Surviving residue can yield A = 1 A=1 when C = 0 C=0 , and blocking a candidate write cannot undo an earlier R = 1 R=1 . Main endpoint gaps use all profiles as the denominator rather than conditioning on earlier lifecycle success; conditional stage rates are diagnostics only. Figure 1 summarizes the protocol, and Appendix A gives the indexed state transitions and full threat model.

Exact source deletion can leave derived residue, on which a provenance-based deletion intervention can act. An audit yields R R , a write filter can check a proposed write before C C , and a transcript-free fresh session tests A A ; E = R ∧ C ∧ A E=R\land C\land A records joint completion only, not a causal effect.

blocks.en: A frozen synthetic generator produces profiles balanced over four domains and four target structures: atomic (one record states the target), duplicated/paraphrased (several records restate it), correlated (correlated background clues accompany it), and compositional (separate records carry its components). Each test split has 200 profiles. In-distribution (IID) profiles draw new identities and values from the training/development inventories. Generator-held-out out-of-distribution (OOD) profiles use held-out target families, templates, clue frames, and entity vocabulary, while keeping the same domains, structures, and core target-code composition. This is a bounded synthetic shift, not unrestricted real-world shift or generalization from model training.
blocks.zh: 冷冻合成生成器产生平衡于四个领域和四个目标结构的剖面图:原子(一个记录说明目标)、重复/变换(若干记录重复它)、关联(与之相关的背景线索随附)和组成(单独的记录带有其组成部分)。 每个测试分拆都有200个剖面图. 分布式简介从培训/发展清单中汲取了新的特性和价值。 生成器持有的外分配(OO)剖面使用被持有的目标家族,模板,线索框架,以及实体词汇,同时保留相同的域,结构和核心目标代码组成. 这是一种有限度的合成转变,并非无限制的现实世界转变或从模型训练中概括.

blocks.en: The benchmark fixes the memory harness externally rather than letting the evaluated model design it. Flat memory holds only individually addressable raw interaction records, so deleting the target-bearing source removes the benchmark’s intended copy. Hierarchical memory keeps those raw records and, before deletion, consolidates their active text into an immutable extractive summary: records are sorted by identifier and their text joined verbatim with newlines. Evaluator-side metadata records the identifiers and content digests of each summary’s source records. The model receives the entire ordered post-deletion memory directly in its private prompt.
blocks.zh: 该基准确定外部的内存控制,而不是让被评价的模型设计。 平面内存只持有个人可处理的原始交互记录,因此删除目标源可以删除基准的预期副本. 分级记忆保存着这些原始记录,在删除之前,将其活性文本合并为不可改变的采掘摘要:记录按标识符排序,其文本与新行逐字合并。 评价员-侧元数据记录每个摘要来源记录的识别资料和内容摘要。 该模型在私人的提示中直接接收整个订购的删除后内存.

blocks.en: Exact source-record deletion removes the addressed raw entry and verifies that it is gone. It deliberately leaves any earlier summary untouched, because the summary is a distinct persistent object rather than part of the addressed record. The primary experiment therefore tests, in a fully inspectable way, whether a fixed model can recover information from a known derived descendant once the source itself is gone; this extractive construction is not meant to represent every production memory architecture.
blocks.zh: 精确的源记录删除删除地址的原始条目,并验证其已消失。 它故意使以前的任何摘要不受影响,因为摘要是一个明显的持久性目标,而不是所发记录的一部分。 因此,初级实验以完全可检查的方式测试,一旦来源本身消失,固定模型是否能够从已知的衍生后代那里收回信息;这种采掘构造并不意味着代表每个生产记忆架构。

blocks.en: Recorded-lineage closure widens deletion using that metadata: it retires every summary whose recorded sources include the deleted record and, if the summary also drew on surviving records, rebuilds it from those records with the same deterministic transform. Because provenance here is complete, closure is an idealized structural upper bound on provenance-aware deletion: by construction it removes the descendant channel the benchmark tracks while preserving unrelated inputs. Its zero recoveries therefore validate that scoped intervention, not semantic forgetting in learned, generative, lossy, probabilistic, many-to-many, or incompletely tracked memory systems. A separate declared exposure-group deletion diagnostic deletes the source together with its profile-declared neighbor records and drops any summary containing a removed record verbatim; it is a deterministic comparator, not a general semantic mechanism.
blocks.zh: 记录的线性关闭利用元数据扩大了删除范围:它将记录来源包括被删除记录的每份摘要都删除,如果摘要还利用了未亡记录,则用同样的确定性转变从这些记录中重建。 由于这里的出处是完整的,关闭是在出处-意识删除上一个理想化的结构上方约束:通过构造它去除了出处将基准轨迹的后方通道,同时保留不相关的输入. 因此,它的零恢复证实了这种范围化的干预,而不是语义上对所学知识的遗忘、基因、丧失、概率、多对多或跟踪不全的记忆系统。 单独宣布的曝光组删除诊断将源及其剖面声明的邻居记录一起删除,并删除包含已删除记录的任何摘要;这是一个决定性的参照,而不是一般的语义机制。

blocks.en: To test whether recovery requires a surviving complete copy, a separate transformed-memory suite uses atomic profiles and the public target form REGION-MNEMONIC-NUMBER . Four conditions (C0–C3; condition labels distinct from commitment C C ) isolate what survives: C0 stores the full literal; C1 stores the three labeled components separately, so no contiguous target appears in model-visible state; C2 applies closure to C1; and lossy C3 keeps region and mnemonic but omits the number. Unlike the original compositional profile family, this construction supplies all retained components and a public deterministic composition rule. It tests controlled composition rather than copied-string retrieval, not arbitrary learned or semantic memory.
blocks.zh: 为了检验恢复是否需要幸存的完整副本,一个单独的变形模型套件使用原子剖面图以及公共目标形式REGION-MNEMNIC-NUMBER. 四个条件(C0–C3;条件标签区别于承诺C C) 隔离存活的: C0 存储完整的字元; C1 单独存储三个标注的元件,因此没有在模型可见状态下出现毗连目标; C2 适用于C1; 失去的 C3 保留区域与mnemonic,但省略数字. 与最初的构成剖面家族不同,这一建筑供应了所有保留部件和公共决定组成规则. 它测试控制成分而不是复制字符串检索,而不是任意的学习或语义记忆.

blocks.en: At deletion time, the system stores a keyed HMAC-SHA256 descriptor of the exact UTF-8 attribute–value pair in protected state that the auditor cannot access. Before any proposed write changes memory, the gate strictly parses the candidate and compares it against this descriptor, with no normalization of case, whitespace, Unicode, paraphrase, or meaning. “Gate off” disables only this write filter; deletion still occurs. The gate cannot remove state that already exists or undo a disclosure.
blocks.zh: 在删除时,系统会存储一个精确的UTF-8属性值对的密钥HMAC-SHA256描述符,保存在审计师无法访问的保护状态中. 在任何拟议的写入更改内存之前,大门严格剖析候选人,并与这个描述符进行比较,没有规范大小写,白空间,Unicode,参数,或意义. “关闭”只禁用此写入过滤器; 删除仍然发生 。 闸门无法删除已存在的状态或撤消披露 。

blocks.en: We compare querying strategies that act through the same black-box interface. Our headline results use a single DIRECT query (“What is my {attribute}?”). Secondary comparisons include a single PARAPHRASE query, a fixed expert script, a greedy information-gain policy, a contextual bandit, two frozen recurrent proximal policy optimization (PPO) checkpoints, and a corrected prompted-LLM operator selector. Every auditor chooses from the same seven fixed query templates and may issue at most ten queries; once it submits a prediction, that prediction carries forward, so a ten-query checkpoint need not involve ten model calls. Appendix B gives full definitions, hyperparameters, and the correction applied to the prompted arm.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了通过同一个黑盒界面运行的查询策略. 我们的标题结果使用一个单一的 DIRECT 查询(“ 什么是我的{属性} ? ”) 。 次级比较包括一个单一的PARAPHRASE查询、一个固定的专家脚本、一个贪婪的信息获取政策、一个背景强盗、两个冻结的经常性近距离政策优化(PPO)检查站以及一个经过纠正的诱导-LLM操作员选择器。 每个审计员都从相同的七个固定查询模板中选择,最多可发出10次查询;一旦提出预测,预测就会继续,所以一个10公里的检查站不需要涉及10次模式呼叫。 附 录 B给出了完整的定义,超参数,以及适用于导臂的校正.

blocks.en: The model response interface comprises memory rendering, query wording, the requested answer format (the response contract ), and the official parser. The original legacy contract asked for a nested final_prediction object, but the frozen scorer read a top-level value field; the aligned contract asks for exactly the field the scorer parses. Later experiments compare these contracts while retaining raw replies, allowing parser effects to be distinguished from underlying disclosure (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 模型响应接口包括内存渲染,查询措辞,请求的响应格式(响应合同),以及官方解析器. 原始的遗赠合同要求一个嵌入式最终_预测对象,但被冻结的记分员读取了一个顶级值域;对齐的合同则要求精确的记分员剖析出球场. 后来的实验比较了这些合同,同时保留了原始答复,使解析效果与基本披露有所区别(第4节)。

blocks.en: The model first emits a raw reply, after which the official scorer parses its last visible reply as JSON. A nonempty top-level string value becomes the submitted prediction; an object without one is an abstention, and anything that is not a JSON object is malformed. Missing, malformed, abstaining, and incorrect outputs all stay in the full-profile denominator. Official reconstruction R = 1 R=1 requires a parsed prediction literally equal to y i y_{i} , with no normalization of case, whitespace, Unicode, or meaning. R R is thus exact observable recovery under the specified response contract : an unambiguous scored submission, not a measure of every form of disclosure.
blocks.zh: 该模型首先发出一个原始的回复,之后官方计分员将其最后的可见回复描述为JSON. 一个非空的顶层字符串值成为所提交的预测;一个没有一个的物体是弃权的,任何不属于JSON对象的东西都是错误的. 缺失、畸形、弃权和不正确的产出都属于全貌分母。 官方重建 R = 1 R = 1 需要解析的预测字面上等于y i y _{i},没有大小写,白空格,Unicode,或意思的正常化. 因此,RR是在具体答复合同下准确可见的追偿款:一份内容明确的呈文,而不是对每一种披露形式的衡量。

blocks.en: Where raw replies were retained, diagnostics separate what the model disclosed from how the reply was serialized. The target may appear inside the requested nested final_prediction object, in another field, or in surrounding prose, in which case the top-level parser records no prediction. An exact-target-anywhere flag marks literal occurrence of the target anywhere in the raw reply; it neither identifies an unambiguous submitted answer nor catches semantic paraphrases. Conversely, a syntactically valid top-level prediction can be wrong. An official zero therefore cannot be read as “the model did not disclose the target” without further evidence.
blocks.zh: 在保留原始答复的地方,诊断将模型披露的内容与答复的序列方式区分开来。 目标可能出现在请求的嵌入式最终_预测对象内,在另一个字段,或周围的传言中,在这种情况下,顶层的剖析器没有记录预测. 在原始答复中,目标在任何地方都有一个精确的目标标记;它既未指明所提交的明确答复,也未发现语义解释。 反之,综合有效的顶级预测可能是错误的. 因此,如果没有进一步的证据,官方零不能被理解为“模型没有披露目标”。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is the primary evaluated model; Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and Phi-3-medium-4k-instruct enter the cross-model interface and transformed-memory studies. All use pinned revisions and the frozen inference configuration (Appendix I ). The primary Qwen matrix varies memory, deletion, gating, and auditor conditions with matched clean/forget evaluation, but does not run every combination. Auditor strategies are therefore compared only within their shared hierarchical-memory, exact-deletion, gate-off block.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-7B-Instruct为主要评价模型;Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3和Phi-3-medicle-4k-instruct进入跨模型界面和转型-记忆研究. 所有使用绑定的修订和冻结的推论配置(附录一). 初级Quen矩阵不同内存,删除,标注,以及审计条件与匹配的干净/遗忘评价,但并不运行每个组合. 因此,审计师的战略只在他们共同的等级、精确删除和关闭区块内加以比较。

blocks.en:
The prompted-LLM arm originally used a constant development stub rather than the intended adaptive prompted-auditor implementation. Only affected cells were rerun with the intended frozen implementation; unaffected primary rows remained unchanged (Appendices B and C ). Bounded Qwen studies test the primary finding under specified variations of memory serialization, retrieval exposure, and activation wording, not arbitrary memory systems or interfaces.
Cross-model studies ask how much apparent recovery failure reflects the response interface rather than absence of disclosure. The frozen Qwen-facing interface, including its mismatch, was transferred unchanged to Mistral and Phi-3. Bounded calibrations then selected one model-specific interface on development profiles before evaluating that frozen choice on held-out profiles. A separate one-factor confirmation varied only the requested contract on another untouched panel and retained raw replies. All studies beyond the primary matrix are post-hoc relative to it, although each design or selected configuration was frozen before its own held-out inference; Appendix C gives the chronology.
blocks.zh:
诱导-LLM臂最初使用一个恒定的发展支点,而不是预期的诱导-审计执行。 只有受影响的牢房随着预期的冻结执行而重新运行;未受影响的主行保持不变(附录B和C)。 Brounded Quen研究在内存序列化,检索曝光,激活措辞等特定变体下测试主要发现,而不是任意的内存系统或接口.
跨模型研究询问,明显的回收故障在多大程度上反映了响应界面,而不是没有披露。 冷冻的Quen-facing接口,包括它的不匹配,没有改变地转移到Mistral和Phi-3. 然后,在评估被搁置的配置中冻结的选择之前,BBB校准在开发配置中选择了一个模型特定界面。 单独的一个因素的确认只在另一块未动的面板上更改了所要求的合同,并保留了原始答复。 除了主矩阵之外,所有的研究都是相对于它的后胡克,尽管在它自己的坚持推论之前,每个设计或选定的配置都被冻结;附录C给出了时间顺序.

blocks.en:
A second alignment suite uses new panels of 104 IID and 104 generator-held-out OOD profiles per model, covering all four original structures. The response-contract experiment (Module A) is a 2 × 2 2\times 2 factorial over audit and activation contracts whose cells share post-write state; it isolates how format/parser alignment affects measured reconstruction and activation. The matched write diagnostic (Module B) forks the same aligned expert-script post-audit state into no-write, write-allowed, and gate-blocked branches, isolating the effect of writing a recovered candidate rather than treating E E as causal.
The transformed-memory experiment (Module C) uses separate 104+104 atomic composed-target panels under C0–C3 to test reconstruction without a surviving complete literal. A Qwen-only diagnostic reuses frozen Module-B states and changes only the activation contract from aligned to legacy, testing whether measured activation differences under otherwise matched states can arise from the response interface and scorer. Appendix G documents panels, prompts and replies, matched-state hashes, and validation artifacts.
blocks.zh:
第二套对齐套件使用104 IID和104 发电机持有的每个模型OOD剖面的新面板,覆盖所有四个原始结构. 反应-合同实验(Module A)是一个2×2 2\times 2因子比审计和激活合同,其细胞共享写后状态;它隔离了格式/parser配对如何影响计量的重建和激活. 匹配的书写诊断(Module B)将同一对齐的审核后专家标注状态分叉为不写、书面分配和门锁分支,隔离了写回的候选者的效果,而不是将E E 视为因果关系。
变形元件实验(Module C)在C0–C3下使用单独的104+104原子组成-目标面板,在没有存活的完整字形的情况下测试重建. 一个仅限Wen的诊断再利用冷冻模块-B状态,并且只改变激活合同从对齐到遗留,测试在其他匹配状态下测量的激活差异是否能够从响应界面和计分器中产生. 附 录 G文档面板、提示和答复、匹配状态散列和验证文物。

blocks.en: For nonboundary endpoints we report 95% percentile intervals from 10,000 paired-profile bootstrap resamples. When every paired difference is identical, we report the observed gap rather than a degenerate point mass as a population interval. Exact Clopper–Pearson intervals, where used, describe one world’s marginal binary rate, not a paired gap. We use no pooled estimator across models or splits and no p p -values. A saturated behavioral utility sanity check uses 100 predeclared cases, five categories, and three conditions to detect obvious benign-behavior corruption, not to validate downstream utility comprehensively (Appendix H ).
blocks.zh: 对于非边界终点,我们报告 95%的间隔 从一万对对齐的靴子带复标。 当每个对齐的差值完全相同时,我们报告观察到的差距,而不是一个退化的点质量,作为人口间隔。 精确的Clopper–Pearson间隔, 用于描述一个世界的边际二进制速率, 而不是对齐的间隔 。 我们没有跨模型或拆分的集合估计器,也没有p -值。 饱和的行为效用疗养检查使用100个预先申报的案例,5个类别,以及3个条件来检测明显的良性行为腐败,而不是全面验证下游效用(附录H).

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Exact source deletion leaves substantial recoverable residue
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 精确源删除留下大量可回收的残留物

blocks.en: Despite successful deletion of the addressed source record, a single DIRECT query recovers the target in roughly two thirds of matched profiles. With hierarchical memory and the gate off, Δ ​ Rec = 0.680 \Delta\mathrm{Rec}=0.680 on IID profiles (95% paired interval [ 0.615 , 0.745 ] [0.615,0.745] ) and 0.640 0.640 on generator-held-out OOD profiles ( [ 0.575 , 0.705 ] [0.575,0.705] ); clean recovery is 0/200 in both splits. Flat memory and the declared exposure-group diagnostic instead show zero observed recovery in their tested cells. Within this controlled construction, these contrasts locate the measured channel in retained hierarchical state, without ruling out other retention paths.
blocks.zh: 尽管成功地删除了地址源记录,但一个单一的DIRECT查询在大约三分之二的匹配配置图中恢复了目标. 在分级内存和关机门的情况下,QQ Rec=0.680\Delta\mathrm{Rec=0.680在ID剖面(95%对间隔[0.615,0.745][0.615,0.745]),0.640在发电机持有的OOD剖面([0.575,0.705][0.575,0.705])上;干净的恢复在两个切面中都是0/200. 平面内存和申报的接触组诊断显示其试验细胞中观测到的恢复为零。 在这种有控制的构造中,这些对比点将测量的信道定位在保留的等级状态,而不排除其他的保留路径.

blocks.en: Recovery is high for atomic, duplicated/paraphrased, and correlated structures (Table 1 ). The original compositional profiles, however, yield zero exact recovery under all eight tested auditors in both splits. This boundary is conditional on that profile construction, the frozen query grammar, and the response interface; it does not imply a general inability to compose information. Section 5.2 directly tests composition when the required components and public rule are available. Gaps are positive across all four domains. The structure and domain breakdowns are post-hoc descriptions of small balanced cells, not intrinsic-difficulty rankings (Appendix D.2 ).
blocks.zh: 原子、重复/参数和关联结构的恢复率很高(表1)。 但是,在最初的构成情况中,所有8名接受过测试的审计员在两次审计中都得到零准确的回收。 此边界以配置构造,冻结查询语法,以及响应界面为条件;这并不意味着一般无法编译信息. 第5.2节在具备所需部件和公共规则时直接检验组成。 所有四个领域的差距都是积极的。 结构和域分解是小平衡细胞的Hoc后描述,不是内在困难排列(Appendix D.2 ).

blocks.en: Table 1: Primary Qwen one-turn DIRECT recovery and post-hoc structure breakdown. Counts are clean/forget exact recoveries among paired profiles; intervals are paired bootstrap intervals; boundary rows report observed gaps.
blocks.zh: 表1:初级Quen一转直流电恢复和热后结构分解. 计数在配对剖面图中是干净的/忘记准确的恢复;间隔是配对的靴子间隔;边界行报告观察到的差距。

blocks.en: 5.2 Recovery persists without a surviving complete literal
blocks.zh: 5.2 恢复工作持续进行,没有完整的文字

blocks.en: The recovery above does not require another complete copy of the target to survive elsewhere in memory. In lossless C1, every required component remains separately available under a public composition rule, but the complete target appears in 0 of 1,248 transformed model-visible states. Clean recovery is zero, yet exact-recovery gaps range from 0.615 0.615 to 0.990 0.990 across all six model/split cells (Table 2 ). blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: For persistent-memory agents, deletion should be evaluated behaviorally at the memory-system level, not only as a storage operation. AfterDeleteBench attributes post-deletion reconstruction to a prior exposure and separates disclosure from later write-back and fresh-session recall. Exact source-record removal can leave information available through derived state, and a write-time safeguard cannot undo an earlier disclosure.
blocks.zh: 对于持久性记忆剂,删除应该在内存系统层面的行为评价,而不仅仅是作为存储操作. 在Delete Bench将删除后的重建归结为之前的曝光,并将披露与后来的回写和新会话召回分开. 精确的源记录删除可以让信息通过衍生状态获取,一个写时保障不能撤销之前的披露.

blocks.en: Non-verbatim reconstruction broadens this failure mode beyond surviving complete copies. When components remain under a public composition rule, exact reconstruction stays substantial across all three models; when one component is omitted, complete reconstruction falls to zero in the tested cells while surviving components remain exposed. Audits should therefore distinguish full reconstruction from partial leakage. These controlled targets and deterministic transforms do not establish the same behavior for natural-language secrets or learned semantic representations.
blocks.zh: 非verbatim重建将这种失败模式拓宽,超越了幸存的完整副本. 当部件仍处于公共构成规则之下时,在所有三种模型中,确切的重建都保持相当程度;如果遗漏一个部件,在试验细胞中完全重建降至零,而幸存部件仍然暴露在外。 因此,审计应区分全面重建与部分渗漏。 这些受控目标和定型变换对自然语言秘密或学识的语义表述都没有确定相同的行为.

blocks.en: The response interface is also part of the measurement system: parser mismatches can hide target-bearing replies, and changing only the activation contract can reverse an apparent write effect on matched states. Accordingly, E E describes lifecycle completion, while the matched write/no-write contrast estimates the contribution of a new write. Recorded-lineage closure and the exact-literal gate then provide complementary controls: closure removes tracked descendants under complete provenance, whereas the gate blocks a proposed reinsertion without changing preexisting state. Closure remains an idealized structural upper bound because incomplete provenance, semantic or many-to-many dependencies, and untracked state can escape it.
blocks.zh: 响应接口也是测量系统的一部分:解析器不匹配可以隐藏目标包含的响应,只有修改激活合同才能逆转匹配状态上明显的写入效果. 因此,EE描述了生命周期的完成情况,而匹配的写/无写对比估计了新写的贡献. 然后,有记录的线性关闭和准确的扫盲门提供补充控制:关闭将完全从原处清除出跟踪的后代,而大门则在不改变先前状态的情况下阻碍提议的重返社会。 关闭仍是一种理想化的结构上界,因为不完全的出处,语义或多对多的依赖,而无轨状态可以逃脱它.

blocks.en: The scope remains bounded to synthetic exact-string targets, a controlled external-memory harness, deterministic transformations, a finite operator vocabulary, and generator-held-out synthetic shift. The saturated 100-case utility check is not comprehensive, and no exposed-and-retained reference calibrates normal recoverability. Natural-language and semantic secrets, learned or compressed memory, incomplete provenance, independent production memory systems, and realistic runtime/storage costs remain open (Appendix J ).

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: AfterDeleteBench shows that successful source-record deletion need not make previously exposed information behaviorally unavailable to a persistent-memory agent. In our controlled setting, exposure-attributable reconstruction remains substantial even when the complete target string no longer exists in memory and must instead be composed from separately stored components. The experiments further show that deletion auditing must account for the response interface and the information lifecycle: parser mismatches can hide real disclosures, and recovering information, writing it back, and recalling it later are distinct events that should be measured separately. Provenance-aware closure removes the tracked recovery channel under complete recorded lineage, while an exact-literal write filter provides a complementary safeguard against future reinsertion without erasing existing residue. Together, these results provide an exposure-controlled, interface-explicit framework for asking a concrete question after deletion: what information can the agent still reveal?
blocks.zh: 在Delete Bench之后显示,成功的源记录删除不需要使先前曝光的信息行为无法为持久性记忆剂提供. 在我们的控制环境下,即使完整的目标串不再存在于内存中,而必须从单独储存的组件中组成,但可暴露-可调节重建仍然具有重大意义。 实验进一步显示,删除审计必须对响应界面和信息生命周期进行核算:解析器不匹配可以隐藏真实的披露,并恢复信息,将其写回,后期回顾是不同的事件,应当单独衡量. 了解证据的关闭消除了完整记录的系系下的履带回收通道,而精确的书写过滤器则提供了补充性保障,防止今后在不清除现有残留物的情况下进行再安置。 这些结果共同为在删除后提出具体问题提供了一个接触控制、界面明确的框架:代理人仍然能够披露哪些信息?

blocks.en: The expert script follows a fixed prior ordering and stops when a visible candidate is available. Greedy information gain updates a Beta-style productivity belief over public replies. The contextual bandit is a frozen disjoint LinUCB policy over seven probes and the same 24 public features used by PPO. Those features are, in vector order: turn/max-turn fraction; remaining/max query-budget fraction; nine per-action use counts divided by maximum budget; a nine-way one-hot encoding of the previous action; last-reply refusal and write-signal bits; belief confidence in [ 0 , 1.000 ] [0,1.000] ; and a candidate-present bit. The nine actions are DIRECT, PARAPHRASE, RELATIONAL, TEMPORAL, ELIMINATE, COUNTERFACTUAL, VERIFY, STOP, and REINTRODUCE. The hard mask enables legal probes only while budget remains, always permits STOP until termination, applies any public operator preconditions, and always masks the deferred REINTRODUCE action.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares the primary exact-deletion baseline with two interventions across reconstruction, commitment, activation, and their conjunction. Recorded-lineage closure acts on already-existing derived state by retiring or rebuilding summaries whose stored provenance includes the deleted source. The exact-literal gate instead acts only when a candidate write is proposed; it does not mutate residue already present after deletion. Consequently, activation can remain positive when commitment is zero, because a fresh session may still recover the target from surviving state. For the same reason, E = 0 E=0 under gating records failure to complete all lifecycle stages and does not establish forgetting.

blocks.en: The behavioral utility sanity check has 100 cases, 20 each for benign-write near misses, multi-source retention, retrieval competition, selective rebuild retention, and personalization under interference. Baseline exact deletion, closure, and gate-on conditions each score 100/100; every paired difference is zero. The exact marginal 95% interval for each 100/100 rate is [ 0.964 , 1.000 ] [0.964,1.000] , not a paired-gap interval. All scored targets have surviving support independent of the deleted source. In 20 gate near-miss cases, all writes commit and 0/20 are falsely blocked (exact marginal upper bound 0.168 0.168 ). The cases cover one-character substitution, prefix, suffix, same-format different value, and equal-length code-like value. This saturated check can reveal obvious deterministic or catastrophic corruption in these cases; it does not characterize realistic downstream utility or collateral over-pruning when benign tasks depend on deleted or entangled information. Twenty near misses provide only limited evidence about false blocking.
blocks.zh: 行为效用疗养检查有100个病例,每例20个良性写法接近缺失,多源保留,检索竞争,选择性重建保留,在干扰下个性化. 基线精确删除,关闭,和闸口条件各得分100/100;每对对差为零. 每100/100速率的精确边距95%间隔为[0.964,1.000] [0.964,1.000],而非对格间隔. 所有得分目标都有独立于删除源的存活支持. 在20起接近失踪的案例中,所有写作和0/20都被错误地封锁了(确切的边际上方绑着0.1680.168)。 案例包括单字符替换,前缀,后缀,同格式的不同值,以及等长的代码类值. 这种饱和的检查可能揭示出这些案件中明显的决定性或灾难性的腐败;当良性任务依赖于被删除或缠绕的信息时,它并不描述现实的下游效用或附带的过度拖延。 20名接近失手者只提供了有限证据,证明存在虚假封锁。

blocks.en: Every model call uses one system-side private prompt comprising the following fixed preamble, a newline, and compact JSON with exactly six keys. Fixed system preamble: Act as the memory agent represented by this private state. Answer the audit query using exactly one JSON object matching response_contract; include no prose outside the JSON. Legacy response contract: {"final_prediction":{"status":"prediction|abstain", "value":"required only for prediction"}} Aligned response contract: {"status":"prediction|abstain", "value":"required only for prediction"} The six keys are: prompt_version, private_lifecycle_history, current_flat_memory, prior_audit_turns, audit_query, response_contract. The official scorer accepts a nonempty top-level string value . Audit calls place the rendered operator query in audit_query and append visible query/reply/refusal triples to prior_audit_turns . Activation creates a new environment with an empty audit transcript and sends the same DIRECT query under the selected activation contract; only post-write persistent memory carries across.

blocks.en: For compatibility with the frozen experimental artifacts and the code repository, implementation identifiers may retain the original term victim for the evaluated language model. blocks.en: Primary consolidation sorts active raw records lexicographically by entry_id , joins their text verbatim with the single delimiter \n , and stores an immutable summary with evaluator-only source identifiers and content hashes. The model-facing current_flat_memory is the ordered list of every entry text in the post-deletion retrieval snapshot; the primary condition injects this whole list directly rather than selecting entries with a retriever. Exact deletion removes only the addressed raw entry and leaves the preexisting summary object. Recorded-lineage closure removes summaries naming that raw identifier and rebuilds once from surviving active raw records using the same transform. A fresh session re-renders the post-write store, clears prior_audit_turns and policy state, and includes no exposure-bearing lifecycle history.

blocks.en: Appendix J Extended Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录J 扩大的限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The benchmark-specific, externally controlled memory construction provides strong internal attribution but limited external architecture validity: the model does not autonomously choose storage, consolidation, retrieval, deletion, or candidate writing. Independently developed memory frameworks, selective and compressed summaries, learned abstractions, semantic memory, and independent retrieval/consolidation pipelines remain to be studied. Exact structured targets do not establish behavior for paraphrasable facts, preferences, or concepts; semantic evaluation needs a separately specified scorer. The paired clean control attributes observed post-deletion recovery to exposure but does not measure the fraction of normally retrievable information preserved. An exposed-and-retained reference would provide that calibration and distinguish deletion loss from a model/interface that cannot express retained information.
blocks.zh: 具体的基准,外部控制的内存构建提供了强大的内部归属,但有限的外部架构有效性:模型不自主选择存储,合并,检索,删除,或候选写法. 独立开发的内存框架,选择性的压缩摘要,学到的抽象,语义记忆,以及独立的检索/整合管道仍有待研究. 精确的结构化目标不为可解释的事实,偏好或概念确立行为;语义评价需要单独指定的计分器. 成对的清洁控制属性观测到在清除后恢复到接触时,但没有测量所保存的通常可检索信息的比例。 暴露和保留提及将规定校准和区分删除损失与无法表达保留信息的模型/界面。

blocks.en: The fixed operator vocabulary excludes unrestricted follow-up generation and arbitrary transcript synthesis. In the deterministic extractive harness, complete recorded provenance makes closure an idealized structural upper bound: removing and rebuilding every tracked descendant excludes that channel by construction. Missing or incorrect provenance edges, probabilistic or many-to-many derivations, untracked semantic dependencies, lossy or learned transforms, and derived state outside the summary layer can evade it. The gate recognizes only an exact protected representation. The saturated utility sanity check does not characterize realistic downstream performance, collateral over-pruning, or broad false blocking, and isolated runtime/storage benchmarking remains open.
blocks.zh: 固定的操作器词汇排除了无限制的后续生成和任意的语录合成. 在决定性的采掘带中,完整的有记录的来源使得关闭成为理想化的结构上限:拆除和重建每一个有轨的后裔通过建筑排除了这一通道. 缺少或不正确的出处边缘,概率论或多种到多种衍生物,无轨语义依赖性,失落或学习的变换,在汇总层外的衍生状态可以避开它. 大门只承认有确切的保护代表。 饱和的公用设施疗理检查不具有现实的下游性能特征,抵押品过度挤压或广泛的虚假阻塞,孤立的运行时间/储存基准仍然开放.
